description: This file defines the class pDraw, an extension providing various methods for drawing shapes, lines, polygons, text, gradients, and handling images within a charting or graphical context. It includes numerous drawing primitives tailored for detailed graphic rendering, such as rounded rectangles, polygons, circles, and Bezier curves, along with support for transparency, anti-aliasing, and external image integration.

classes.name: pDraw
classes.description: A class providing comprehensive drawing methods for complex graphical rendering, including shapes, lines, text, gradients, image overlays, and anti-aliasing, primarily used in chart and graphic generation contexts.

methods.name: countDrawableSeries
methods.description: Returns the number of drawable data series in the dataset.

methods.name: fixBoxCoordinates
methods.description: Ensures coordinate pairs are ordered to define a proper box with top-left and bottom-right points.

methods.name: drawPolygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon defined by a set of points with specified formatting options such as color and border.

methods.name: offsetCorrection
methods.description: Applies anti-aliasing correction to boundary values depending on the mode.

methods.name: drawRoundedRectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with rounded corners using specified radius and formatting.

methods.name: drawRoundedFilledRectangle
methods.description: Draws a filled rectangle with rounded corners, including optional shadow handling.

methods.name: drawRoundedFilledRectangle_deprecated
methods.description: An older method for drawing filled rounded rectangles, now deprecated.

methods.name: drawRectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle outline with specified color, transparency, and style options.

methods.name: drawFilledRectangle
methods.description: Draws a filled rectangle with optional border and dash styles.

methods.name: drawRectangleMarker
methods.description: Draws a small square marker at a specified point.

methods.name: drawSpline
methods.description: Draws a spline curve based on Bezier segments with given coordinates and formatting.

methods.name: drawBezier
methods.description: Draws a Bezier curve with control points, supporting arrowheads and segments.

methods.name: drawLine
methods.description: Draws a straight line with optional weight and style, with support for anti-aliasing and shadows.

methods.name: drawCircle
methods.description: Draws an outline of a circle with specified center, size, and styling.

methods.name: drawFilledCircle
methods.description: Draws a filled circle with optional border and shadow effects.

methods.name: drawText
methods.description: Renders text at specified coordinates with font, style, alignment, and optional background box.

methods.name: drawGradientArea
methods.description: Fills a rectangular area with a gradient in specified direction and color transition.

methods.name: drawAntialiasPixel
methods.description: Draws an anti-aliased pixel with color and transparency blending.

methods.name: drawAlphaPixel
methods.description: Draws a semi-transparent pixel with consideration for existing mask and shadow.

methods.name: convertAlpha
methods.description: Converts transparency from percentage to alpha value used in image functions.

methods.name: allocateColor
methods.description: Allocates a color with transparency in a given image, capping RGB and Alpha values.

methods.name: drawFromPNG
methods.description: Loads and overlays a PNG image at specified position.

methods.name: drawFromGIF
methods.description: Loads and overlays a GIF image at specified position.

methods.name: drawFromJPG
methods.description: Loads and overlays a JPEG image at specified position.

methods.name: getPicInfo
methods.description: Returns the size and type info of an image file.

methods.name: drawFromPicture
methods.description: Generic method to load and draw external images of various formats (PNG, GIF, JPEG).

methods.name: drawArrow
methods.description: Draws an arrow between two points with customizable fill, border, size, and ratio.

methods.name: drawArrowLabel
methods.description: Draws a label with an associated arrow pointing to a specific point.

methods.name: drawProgress
methods.description: Draws a progress bar filled with a specified percentage, supporting vertical and horizontal orientation.

methods.name: getLegendSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the legend box based on series descriptions and formatting options.

methods.name: drawLegend
methods.description: Draws the legend box with series indicators, icons, and labels.

methods.name: drawScale
methods.description: Configures and draws axes scales, ticks, labels, and grid lines according to chart data and formatting.

methods.name: getAbscissaMargin
methods.description: Returns the margin size for the X-axis based on data axis configuration.

methods.name: drawShape
methods.description: Draws various predefined shape types (circle, square, triangle, diamond, etc.) at specified coordinates with styling parameters.

methods.name: drawPolygonChart
methods.description: Draws a filled polygon shape based on a set of points, with options for fill, border, and threshold coloring.
